newsitem.title: UK: Transco and UK gas shippers adapt to hard landing.
newsitem.headline: Transco and UK gas shippers adapt to hard landing.

text.p: Gas trading in the U.K. market ran smoothly on Monday, the day after the introduction of strict new rules for market users, pipeline operator Transco and gas shippers said on Monday.
"The operational systems are working adequately," said Graham Ryott, gas trading support manager at Transco, the pipeline arm of British Gas.
The so-called "hard landing" of the Network Code gas shipping rules came into effect on Sunday.
The hard landing imposes financial penalties on shippers if their offtake from Transco's pipeline system is not matched by inputs on a a daily basis.
"I think we're finding it more challenging to keep our inputs and outputs balanced," said a trader for a major gas shipper.
"We're trading more smaller quantities to keep in balance."
